assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single production exploration map asset for a Japanese 16-bit pixel-art fantasy RPG, area Ashen a01 醒石边地 (do not render text). Wide 16:9 composition, elevated three-quarter top-down view looking down on a complete small region, no sky or horizon. Dense crisp hand-placed-looking pixel clusters and limited earthy palette, genuinely pixel art not painted realism. Wind has swept ancient gray ash off ochre stone ridges; white salt crust surrounds small drinkable turquoise mineral-dew pools. Clear interconnected pale trails wind between ridges and pools, linking an open field at lower-left, a dark rocky cavern entrance around center-right, and neighboring exits at left/right edges. Layered rock terraces and tiny salt crystals provide rich geography. No people, no monsters, no castle or unrelated buildings, no labels, text, icons, border or UI. Distinct region with multiple paths, NOT a side-scrolling battle arena or empty central fighting floor. Opaque full-bleed image intended to be downscaled to 480x270.
